# Scenario Instructions: .NET Version Upgrade

## Scenario
Upgrade eShopOnWeb from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 LTS

## Parameters
- **Solution**: /home/runner/work/eShopOnWeb/eShopOnWeb/eShopOnWeb.sln
- **Target Framework**: net10.0
- **Working Branch**: upgrade/dotnet-10
- **Input Mode**: solution

## User Preferences

### Execution Style
- Flow Mode: Automatic (no pauses for user input)

## Decisions
- Target .NET 10.0 LTS (end-of-life Nov 2028)
- Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution
